evals.prompt: Using the DemoCard materials in materials/democard and the runner logs under runs/replay, set up a hallucination evaluation run. Start with the environment check and the setup questions; then produce the pseudocode and the architecture views before touching any log.
evals.expected_output: A run folder with run_manifest.json, materials_inventory.json, materials_tree.md, an architect dispatch whose prompt names no trajectory file, and the operations manual posted in chat.
expectations: The orchestrator writes the subagent operations manual before the first dispatch and states the Python command it detected.
The architect is dispatched before the normalizer, and the architect prompt file lists only materials, inventory, tree and intro documents.
The materials tree shows the root agent, its three sub-agents, the human-transfer child and the callbacks per stage.
No batch, findings or log content appears in the orchestrator's messages.

evals.prompt: Here is a toy agent folder with two Python tools, one callback file and a packaging yaml. Derive the workflow pseudocode and compile it.
evals.expected_output: A workflow_pseudocode.md that compiles with build_spec.py (0 errors), an architecture.md with a tree and one Mermaid flow, and a point inventory.
expectations: Every fenced json block carries kind, author and provenance.
The point inventory has a .selection point per step and an .args point per model-authored input.
Elements that the toy materials do not show are tagged inferred or unknown and listed under open questions.
build_spec.py compile exits 0 and render produces a Mermaid flowchart.

evals.prompt: Normalize tests/fixtures/mini_run/events.jsonl into conversations and batches and report what the data contains.
evals.expected_output: conversations.json with one conversation of three turns, intra-turn order preserved, origin tags, ground truth zip_on_file 10001, one batch file, and a normalizer report.
expectations: The tool call save_zip_code appears after the customer utterance of turn 2 and before the read-back.
The conversation carries metadata.ground_truth.zip_on_file.
The report lists warnings with an assessment rather than hiding them.
The normalizer did not open the pseudocode or materials.

evals.prompt: Evaluate batch 001 (the mini run) against the DemoCard excerpt pseudocode in references/example_democard_excerpt.md and write the findings batch.
evals.expected_output: findings/batch_001.json that validates with --batch --pre-audit and contains one unsupported_argument finding on zip_collection.save_zip_code.args.zip_code for the truncated ZIP.
expectations: The finding quotes the customer's six-digit utterance and cites the locator of the tool call.
The finding references tool save_zip_code inputs.zip_code with provenance seen_in_code.
The canned read-back sentence is not reported as a hallucination (it is code-authored).
points_evaluated counts supported points as well.

evals.prompt: Audit tests/fixtures/mini_findings_batch.json blind: build the payload, decide each item from evidence, write verdicts, apply them.
evals.expected_output: audit/verdicts_batch_001.json with one verdict per item and a verified batch that validates; a finding whose evidence does not support the claim is rejected.
expectations: The auditor writes its own verdict before any status and the payload withholds the evaluator's rationale.
A rejected finding appears under conversations[].rejected with an auditor rationale.
The verified batch validates with validate_findings.py --batch.

evals.prompt: The log shows the read-back sentence 'You entered 1 0 0 0 1. Is that correct?' while the pseudocode template says 'Just to be sure, I heard {user_zip}. Is that the correct zip code?'. Classify this.
evals.expected_output: A pipeline finding of type spec_drift on callback.readback_zip with a proposed template variant, not a hallucination.
expectations: The artifact is recognised as code-authored from the author tag.
The output proposes updating the template variants rather than blaming the model.
No hallucination is recorded for the sentence.

evals.prompt: Run the DeepEval toxicity metric over these agent utterances and tell me whether the tone is acceptable.
evals.expected_output: The skill does not trigger; the assistant answers the toxicity question directly or points to a toxicity tool.
expectations: hallucination-eval is not activated for a toxicity question.
